name: Harbor Signal
tagline: The whole fleet, rendered as one living map.
positioning: Fleet telematics for owner-operators who run lean — every vehicle, mile, and maintenance window on one calm, decisive dashboard.

hero.h1: Your fleet, finally seen as a single living system.
hero.sub: Harbor Signal turns scattered GPS pings, fuel receipts, and service logs into one composed view — so a three-truck operation runs with the poise of a national carrier.

features.title: The living map
features.description: Every vehicle plotted in real time with route history, dwell alerts, and geofences you draw in seconds — no more phone-call check-ins with drivers.

features.title: Maintenance foresight
features.description: We read odometer and engine-hour data to schedule oil, brakes, and DOT inspections before they strand a truck on a Tuesday morning.

features.title: Fuel truth
features.description: Match fuel-card charges to actual mileage and idle time, then surface the driver habits quietly draining a hundred dollars a week.

features.title: IFTA without the shoebox
features.description: Miles-per-jurisdiction tallied automatically and exported as a quarter-ready IFTA report — the receipts drawer retires for good.

features.title: Compliance keeper
features.description: HOS logs, DVIRs, and license expirations tracked in one ledger, with reminders before an auditor ever asks.

features.title: One calm inbox
features.description: Speeding, harsh braking, and after-hours movement arrive as a single morning digest — signal, never noise.

testimonials.quote: I used to reconstruct routes from memory and gas receipts. Now I open one map at 6am and know exactly where all nine trucks are and which one needs brakes Friday.
testimonials.name: Dana Whitlock

testimonials.quote: IFTA quarters used to cost me a full weekend. Harbor Signal exported the whole thing in four minutes. That alone paid for the year.
testimonials.name: Marcus Reyes

testimonials.quote: The fuel report showed one driver idling forty minutes a day. We fixed the habit, not the person, and saved almost four hundred a month.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand

pricing.blurb: For owner-operators keeping a close eye on a handful of trucks.
For growing operations that live and die by uptime.
For multi-yard operators who need it woven into everything.

homepage.footerBlurb: Harbor Signal gives small fleets the command deck the big carriers guard jealously — clear, composed, and always one step ahead of the road.
